doc_title: APPLICATION FOR CANCELLATION OF EASEMENT/ANALOGOUS RIGHTS BY PERSON OCCUPYING SERVIENT LAND
doc_title_official: APPLICATION FOR CANCELLATION OF EASEMENT/ANALOGOUS RIGHTS BY PERSON OCCUPYING SERVIENT LAND
when_used: The person occupying the servient land applies to cancel an easement or analogous right shown on the title.

body_text.text: being the person occupying the servient land DO HEREBY cancel the above easement/analogous right granted/created as shown above.
